test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: Which skill is used by a reader when he evaluates the same information and makes judgments based on evidence?
solution:
The correct answer is: Critical skill. 
Critical skill is required when a reader evaluates information and makes judgments based on evidence, as it involves analyzing and assessing the validity and reliability of the content.
